Commentary.Commentary: Alright then. Did we see this coming? Bangladesh trouncing the Windies? Ummm... perhaps we did. This unit in Green is way too confident right now while the visitors are losing their competitive edge with every game they play. Can we see some more competitiveness in the next game? Join us for the second ODI on Tuesday, December 11, 2018 at 1 pm local (0700 GMT). ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Victorious Bangladesh captain, Mashrafe Mortaza has been named the MAN OF THE MATCH. Feels that Windies are dangerous in this format and hence, is happy with his bowlers for keeping them quiet and not allowing the opposition to forge a partnership. On the ploy to open with spin, Mortaza says that he just wanted to spring a surprise, given the way the Windies collapsed against spin in the Tests. Praises Rahim, Liton and Shakib for playing well and being professional. On his upcoming 200th match in the third ODI in Sylhet, Mashrafe deflects the question away, saying that he has got other challenges in mind, stating that the second ODI is to be played first.

Windies skipper, Rovman Powell, admits that the toss was a big factor. Agrees that the batting was not great which brought about their downfall and hopes that there is a better performance in the next game. Scrutinizes that batsmen getting in did not make use of their starts. On the pitch, Powell says that he thought that the difficulty to bat would have been only for some time but got surprised to see that for so long. Credits the entire support staff and the seniors for helping him in his captaincy stint.

Should Powell have elected to chase? There was plenty of dew around and the bowlers were finding it difficult to grip the ball. Worth a thought if he does win the toss in the second game, which is at this same venue. As he impressed in India, Oshane Thomas rung the alarm bells here as well. But only in his first spell. After he was seen off, there was hardly any threat from the other bowlers. Please stay tuned for the presentation.

Perhaps Rovman Powell could have set attacking fields. Maybe, he might have got a couple of more wickets. Bangladesh were 2 down in Powerplay 1 but once the fielding restrictions were over, the Windies just spread the field, allowing a partnership to grow. Mushfiqur Rahim and Liton Das made full use of that, soaking in the early pressure and then the former used his experience to guide his side through, with help from Shakib.

196 was never a massive target but the Windies could have made the victory a bit difficult. They dismissed Tamim and Kayes in the span of 5 balls but the Rahim-Das partnership pegged them back. And then, Shakib's cameo sealed the deal.

Easy peasy then. Won't say the hosts have won without breaking a sweat as losing two quick wickets would have put a doubt in their minds but eventually, the lack of a bigger target enabled them to cruise home.

VICTORY FOR BANGLADESH! In a pretty convincing manner. Full and around off, Rahim comes forward to defend but the ball spins away, takes the outside edge and goes well wide of first slip. Backward point has some work to do before he can get to the ball and by that time, the required two runs are taken. BANGLADESH WIN BY 5 WICKETS WITH 89 BALLS TO SPARE!
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
A full toss outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Similar ball, squeezed to backward point this time.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Dead ball. Paul comes running in but then loses his runup as he approaches the umpire. Aborts it.
Full and straight, the batsman looks to defend but is early and gets a leading edge towards cover.
Full and outside off, almost a yorker, nicely squeezed behind point for a couple. While taking the first run, Mahmudullah almost collided with the bowler.
Short and outside off, Mushfiqur looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to the off side.
Outside off, forced wide of sweeper for a run.
Short and outside off, cut through the covers for a single.
On middle and leg, nudged towards short fine leg.
Around off, defended back to the bowler watchfully this time.
Ooohhh.. full and around off, Rahim is early into his flick and gets a leading edge. Almost carries to the bowler.
Devendra Bishoo to bowl now. 5-0-26-0 so far.
Short and outside off, Rahim leaps and cuts it towards third man for a run. The hosts are a hit away from victory.
Too full, around middle, clipped towards square leg for another single.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid off for a quick single.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
On middle, worked wide of mid on. He wants a single initially but then changes his mind.
Full and straight, dug out back to the bowler.
On middle and leg, worked towards square leg.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.

31ST ODI FIFTY FOR RAHIM! 4th against the Windies. Full and outside off, Mushfiqur pushes it towards point and sets off for a single. However, he stops on seeing that Mahmudullah is not responding. Eventually, they cross over and the crowd applauds.
Landed outside off, this time the batsman goes back and plays it with the turn through square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, Mahmudullah gets a big stride forward and blocks.
Tailing in, around off, flicked away to deep mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
Landed outside off, Rahim waits for the ball to come to him and steers it towards third man for a run.
A short ball, kicks off the surface, Mahmudullah nudges it towards fine leg for a single. 19 more required.
Outside off, played straight to point.
A yorker to begin his new spell. It is around middle, Mahmudullah digs it towards mid-wicket, Rahim wants a single but then, on seeing that his brother-in-law is stumbling a bit, sends him back.
Keemo Paul comes back into the attack. 5-0-29-1 so far.
On middle and off, watchfully defended in front of mid-wicket.
Landed outside off, Mahmudullah goes back and punches it towards point for a single to get off the mark.
Around off, blocked back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
Mahmudullah walks in next at number 7, replacing Sarkar.

OUT! That Drinks break has broken the concentration of Sarkar. Classic off-spinner's dismissal. Full and outside off, Soumya reaches out to push but the ball spins away, takes the outside edge and skipper Rovman Powell pockets a simple catch at first slip. Just delaying the inevitable. Only 21 more needed.
WIDE. Fired down the leg side, Sarkar misses his flick.
Full and around off, spinning in, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

DRINKS BREAK. Well, does anyone need this break right now? But such are the laws of the game. Just 23 runs more needed and Bangladesh are about to finish this off in a jiffy. Given the way Soumya is playing, it could be done and dusted with in the next couple of overs.
Outside off, watchfully left alone. 16 from the over.
SIX! Ho ho ho! This is even better! Thomas does not learn and goes shorter and quicker. Outside off, Sarkar leaps and upper cuts it over deep backward point!

FOUR! Smart batting. Short and outside off, Sarkar arches back, uses the pace of the bowler and ramps it wide of square third man. 29 more needed now. Soumya moves to 13 from 10 balls and this stand is worth 21 from 15 deliveries.
Full and wide outside off, Sarkar slashes hard but misses.
On middle and leg, helped through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! JUST WIDE! That made Rahim hop. He was not on total control as he tried to work a short ball around the corner but the pace did him in. He tucked it towards fine leg but his heart would have been in his mouth when Shai Hope dived to his left.
WIDE. A fiery ball but down the leg side. Flick shot missed.
Oshane Thomas is back on. 4-0-18-1 so far.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
On middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a run. 39 more needed from 133 deliveries.
Full on middle and leg, flicked uppishly through mid-wicket for one. The stand moves to 10 from 9 balls.
Works it through square leg for a run.
Landed outside off, Rahim comes forward to defend initially but the ball spins back in a long way and he shows his back to it. Gets hit on the body.
Full on middle, pushed towards long on for a single.
Pushes this through mid on for one more.
FOUR! Not in total control. A length ball outside off, Sarkar chips it over mid off and gets a boundary. Almost gave a simple catch.
Outside off, chipped over cover for a couple. 48 more needed from 140 balls.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

SAFE. Full and outside off, Sarkar drives it towards mid off. He initially calls for a single but then sends Rahim back. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end and it is referred upstairs but no harm done to the home side.
And we have a run out appeal straightaway. Is Rahim safe?
Soumya Sarkar is the new man in at number 6, replacing Shakib.

OUT! Caught behind! The captain has struck first ball. Can he produce some inspiration and get Windies back into the game? Not many runs to play with. A loose shot from Shakib. He was anyways playing in a manner to finish the game quickly and has eventually perished. Full and wide outside off, Shakib looks to drive but with his feet glued to the crease. An outside edge is induced and Shai Hope takes the simplest of catches. A breezy cameo from the former captain and one would guess that should be more than enough for a 1-0 series lead. Just 50 more needed from 143 balls.
Rovman Powell brings himself on.
FOUR! AWESOME! Full and outside off, Rahim leans into this one and drives it through the covers!
On middle and leg, swept through mid-wicket for a run.
Backs a long way down the leg side but the bowler follows him. He looks to cut but misses. The ball goes past the leg stump.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, Al Hasan looks to cut but misses.

EDGED, BUT NO ONE TO TAKE IT! Might have been a big moment but hard to say so with confidence. It was a short ball outside off and Shakib went back to cut. But the ball came in with the angle and he got cramped for room. An outside edge was induced but there was no one at slip. Two runs to third man.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total. 50-RUN STAND IS UP! Windies are being shut out of the game. 13 from the over!
FOUR! Stunning shot. Full on middle, Shakib just drives it straight back past the bowler down the ground! 58 more needed now, from 151 deliveries.
The batsman guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Rahim slashes hard and gets a top edge over the slip cordon to the third man fence!
ANOTHER WIDE. Landed outside off, darting in, Mushfiqur looks to tuck but misses due to the massive movement.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single. 69 more needed from 155 balls.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Rahim brings out the reverse sweep and gets it over short third man for a boundary!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
WIDE. Down the leg side this time, flick shot missed.
Full and outside off, Shakib lofts it over cover for a single.

What an imperious shot. Even before the ball was bowled, Shakib was standing outside his leg stump, daring the bowler to bowl at the sticks. What he got was a long hop. Cracked it through the covers for a couple.
This time he gets across and works it through square leg for a single.
Landed outside off, spinning in, Rahim goes back and plays it towards short third man.
Roston Chase is back on. 4-1-16-1 so far.
Landed outside off, angling in, dabbed towards third man for a run. 79 more needed from 162 balls.
That is a cracking pull shot. But only for a single. The ball was pitched outside off and Shakib latched onto the short ball in a flash. Towards deep mid-wicket it went.
Down the leg side, tickled fine for a run.
Outside off, this is forced through point for a couple.
Lucky again. A short ball outside off, Rahim looks to pull but is a tad early into the shot. Gets a bottom edge which hits him on the body.
Around off, defended watchfully.
Kemar Roach is back on. 4-0-17-0 so far.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full and around off, watchfully pushed away for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
He is taking the attack to the opposition. Full and around off, Al Hasan gets down and mows the sweep through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, cut through the covers for a couple.
TOP EDGE, SAFE AGAIN! Full and around off, Rahim gets down to sweep but the ball takes the top edge. Luckily for him, there is no man present at short fine leg. A single taken.

FOUR! Another boundary! Even better from Shakib. The length is fuller and Al Hasan promptly drives it through mid on. The fielder is a bit wide and it beats him. Shakib moves to 13 from 11 balls and this is his third boundary.

FOUR! Lovely shot. On a length outside off, Shakib punches it through the covers and gets a boundary. The stand is now worth 12 from 15 balls. 100 UP FOR BANGLADESH. Another 95 needed from 175 deliveries.
Full and straight, driven back to the bowler.
Full and around off, chipped uppishly down the ground, well short of mid on. A quick single is taken. The runs required are now down to double figures. 99 more needed from 177 balls.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
Full and around off, driven straight back.
Around off, defended from the crease.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full on middle, pushed past the bowler towards long on for a run.

Dangerous shot. The ball is pitched outside off and Shakib tries to be too cheeky, attempting to run it down to third man but the ball spins in a mile. Nearly goes through but he manages to make contact.
Landed on middle, worked to the leg side for a single.
Full and outside off, coming in, driven back to the bowler.
FOUR! Quality shot. Dropped short, Shakib swivels and pulls it behind square leg. The good thing about that shot was that the ball was not in the air for a long time.
Full and around off, coming in, pushed back to Paul again.
Full and around off, watchfully pushed back to the bowler.
Shakib Al Hasan walks in at number 5, replacing Das.

OUT! BOWLED! That is a poor shot. A nothing delivery, on a length, just outside off. Das however, tries to manufacture a pull shot, in a lazy manner. Just looks to whip without moving his feet and pays the price. Is nowhere near the ball and misses. The stumps are rattled. The 47-run stand is broken but Bangladesh need 107 more from 190 balls.
Two leg byes. Full and down the leg side, Das misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads through fine leg.
Fuller in length, watchfully kept out.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Around off, solidly defended.
FOUR! Lucky this time. Full and around middle, Rahim looks to reverse sweep but the ball takes the top edge and goes over short third man to the fence.

SAFE. The foot was dragged out but it came back in. Not quite sure whether there was a nick though. Plenty of drama. Full and outside off, Rahim came forward to defend but the ball spun away into Shai Hope's gloves. The bowler appealed and then started to celebrate as well but then realized that the keeper is not appealing for the catch. The captain now gets involved and has a chat with Hope and Bravo, who was at first slip. The latter two seem to indicate that they did not hear any noise and the review thought got aborted. But Hope did ask the square leg umpire about the stumping and it was referred upstairs. Replays show that the foot did come out but before Shai could affect the stumping, it came back in.
Is that a wicket? Could be a catch, could be a stumping... it is the latter which is referred upstairs.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! Lucky boundary! Full and outside off, Das looks to drive but the ball goes off the outside edge, through the vacant slip cordon to the third man fence!
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.
On middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
WIDE. A full ball down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. One run added to the total.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Keemo Paul returns. 2-0-8-0 so far.
Full on middle, the sweep is employed, behind square leg for another single.

Lovely shot. A correction from the one he played on ball number 3. There, he was not to the pitch of the ball. This time, he slightly delayed his jump, got to the pitch of the ball and lofted it gloriously over cover. A couple taken and the stand is worth 31 from 43 deliveries.
Full and outside off, pushed past the diving bowler towards long off for one. MR moves to 10.
Comes down the track but is not quite to the pitch of the ball. Looks to go inside out but skews it over point. A run taken.
Shorter in length, this time Mushfiqur goes back and punches it through the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, Rahim comes forward and then lets it go, carefully watching it spin away.

DRINKS BREAK. A good passage of play. Windies have mixed pressure with freebies and Bangladesh have mixed caution with carelessness. They are slightly ahead on the comparison worm at the end of 15 overs but their batsmen are far more superior in comparison to the visitors. They should pull it off but a couple of quick wickets and funny things can happen.
On a length outside off, played straight to point.
A bit loose now. Outside off, on a length, Das plays away from his body without moving his feet and gets beaten.
Full and around off, driven back to the bowler.
WIDE. Slips this down the leg side, Liton lets it pass.
FOUR! Fine shot. The length is not all that short but Das goes back and punches it on the up through the covers. 129 more needed from 213 balls.
Now a short ball, outside off, Das hops and defends.
Full on middle, almost a yorker, dug out towards short mid-wicket.
Full ball on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Outside off, Liton looks to defend but misses.
FOUR! That relieves the pressure. Short and outside off, Das rocks back and cuts it behind point for a boundary!
Full and around middle, Rahim looks to sweep but gets a top edge. However, there is no short fine leg and the ball lands safely. A single taken.
Outside off, spinning in, pushed straight to point.
Devendra Bishoo introduced now.
A short ball, around off, MR leaps and works it through square leg for a run. 139 more needed from 222 balls.
Landed on a length outside off, Mushfiqur gets on top of the bounce and punches it through the covers. Two runs taken.
On a length around off, pushed towards cover.
Another quick ball. Short and wide outside off, at 142 kph, Rahim slashes hard, looking to cut but there is no feet movement and he misses.
Around off, solidly defended.
Outside off, played through point for a single.
A short ball outside off, Rahim stays back to defend but the ball jags back in off the seam to hit him on the body.
WIDE. A length ball down the leg side, Rahim misses his flick.
Outside off, played through point but a good stop prevents runs.
A short ball outside off, Das sways away and dabs it uppishly towards third man for a single.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Landed outside off, stays low, Das plays inside the line and is beaten.
Outside off, played through point for a single.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. One run added to the total.
WIDE. Miles outside off, Mushfiqur lets it go.
A bouncer outside off, Rahim sways away.
Down the leg side, flicked through fine leg for a single.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Outside off, on a length, Das feels for it but the ball keeps on rising and beats him.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
POWERPLAY 2 time. 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a couple. 47/2 for Bangladesh in Powerplay 1. 31/1 for the Windies.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE. That is too high. A short ball outside off, Das ducks.
Outside off, played straight to point.
That is a terrific short ball. Landed outside off, Das looks to defend but the ball rises steeply and hits him on the gloves. He winces in pain.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
Keemo Paul introduced.

DOT BALL. On this Free Hit as well. Maybe, if a set batsman had played this, it would have been runs. Rahim is new to the crease and perhaps his feet are not moving that quickly. He backs away in advance and slashes hard, attempting an upper cut but misses. Terrific over from Oshane.
Second Free Hit.
NO BALL! Oversteps does Thomas and bowls a half volley, Rahim pushes it towards mid on.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Mushfiqur Rahim walks in at number 4, replacing Kayes.

OUT! BOWLED! Beaten by pace! What a ball from Thomas. Fiery pace. Bowled at 144.2 kph, on a length outside off. Kayes looks to defend but the ball snakes in off the seam, before the bat can even come down. Even when it does, it is outside the line. Kaboom. Timber.
FOUR! Streaky. On a length outside off, Kayes looks to defend but is squared up. The ball takes the outside edge and goes past second slip to the third man fence.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
A bouncer, around off, Das ducks.
Imrul Kayes walks in at number 3, replacing Tamim. Meanwhile, Oshane Thomas is called to bowl.

OUT! Tamim departs! Big wicket for the Windies. Outside off, Tamim looks to cut but the bounce gets big on him. He looks to check his shot but ends up slicing it. A simple catch to Devendra Bishoo at cover-point.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Short and outside off, sliced behind point for a couple.
FOUR! Another boundary. Second in the over. Full and outside off, Das gets down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Outside off, a play and a miss.
FOUR! Full and around middle, Das gets down and sweeps it behind square leg for a boundary! First of the run chase!
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Nothing on the Free Hit. A short ball outside off, Das looks to pull but misses and is hit on the body.
FREE HIT TIME!

IT IS A NO BALL! Criminal from Roach. Das gets a life. First, let us describe the drama and then the suspense. A short ball, outside off, Das pulls it towards mid-wicket but finds Shimron Hetmyer in the deep to perfection! But hang on. The umpires want to check for the no ball and plenty of replays are shown - the foot is ON THE LINE and eventually it is signalled a no ball. Das is called back.
NO BALL? Das has been caught but has Roach overstepped? Referred upstairs...
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
Dropped short, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
A short ball, around off, Tamim goes back and heaves it uppishly but the ball does not carry to deep mid-wicket. Just a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
On middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Comes down the track again and swings hard but is not quite to the pitch of the ball. Miscues his shot and almost holes out to dep mid-wicket. A single taken.
Full and outside off, Das comes down the track and drives it back to the bowler.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Outside off, LD opens the face of his bat and guides it past the widish gully to third man for a single.
WIDE. Third wide of the over. Roach is having a torrid time finishing this over.

THAT STAYED LOW. Tamim did well to adjust. It was a short ball around off, the southpaw looked to pull but the ball shot extremely low. Somehow, he managed to get it through mid-wicket for a run. 179 more needed from 272 balls now.
Outside off, TI punches it through the covers for a couple.
WIDE. Second of this over and this is a monstrous one. Would have been wide for a right-hander too. Short and miles down the leg side. Iqbal swivels and then shoulders arms.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
WIDE. Slips this down the leg side, Tamim misses his flick.
A wayward bouncer, short and outside off, way too high, ducked under.
Turn and bounce again, outside off, LD looks to defend but is consumed by the extra bounce once again. That will make the batsmen think.

TURN AND BOUNCE! That is a surprise. Flighted outside off, Das comes forward to defend but out of nowhere, the ball spits up, bounces up towards his chest and Liton has to adjust to defend. Cannot do so and the ball flies off the edge but wide of short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for one.
Full and around off, pushed towards long on for a run.
Full and around off, Tamim stays leg side of the ball and drives it wide of mid off for a single.
On middle and leg, helped through mid-wicket for another single.
Outside off, pushed through point for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Around off, solidly defended.

FOUR LEG BYES! Poor keeping. A length ball down the leg side, Das misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads. Shai Hope behind dives to his left and should have stopped it but the ball sneaks through.
The batsman has played it to the point region. Excellent over from Chase - A MAIDEN.
Full and around off, watchfully pushed back to the bowler.
EDGED, BUT SAFE! Full and outside off, Tamim pushes at it but the ball spins away and takes the outside edge. Because he played it with soft hands, the ball does not carry to first slip.
Outside off, spinning away slightly, left alone.
Around off, solidly defended.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Roston Chase to bowl with the second new ball.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On a good length around off, Das stays back and blocks.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A length ball down the leg side, helped through fine leg for a single. Bangladesh are away.
Welcome back for the run chase. Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das are the openers for Bangladesh. Kemar Roach will bowl with the first new ball. Tamim on strike. Here we go!
